about: Owner corrections to the approved (16a) river network, applied by compile_hydrology on top of approved-routing-16a.npz (decision 0060 §7). A row declares a box of coarse cells that is NOT the sea (it becomes sea-level water a river crosses) and re-routes one river's last stretch from its 16a mouth (`fromMouth`, a position: river ids are keyed by mouth cell and move with it) to the open-sea cell nearest the point named, by the lowest path over the current ground. Coordinates in metres east/south.

corrections.why: Owner 2026-09-13: the 16a mouth at 6.71 E 0.78 S sits in a pocket the 2.5 km ocean rule called sea; it is a cul-de-sac off the inlet, and the river should run on south to the inlet's real mouth near 6.57 E 0.97 S.
